mechanism: Full ImageClickAction175 and ChapterImage453 read. BaseQuestFile creates all chapter images in image list/object map/dataCache (missing old id generates new), then second pass readData applies legacy click if present else current click_action. Prefix # maps to typed OPEN_QUEST retaining actual quest hex id and optional page; URI/custom/command normalize to same enum-data domain. Actual non-editor-filtered or editable image becomes ChapterImageButton; leftclick dispatches run after editor ctrl/alt branches. OPEN_QUEST resolves real current ClientQuestFile object by parsed hex id, Optional current screen, selects target chapter/views quest or questlink/task through QuestScreen.open; actual selectChapter and viewQuest update selected chapter/modal and history. Fresh compound image writer emits canonical action id:data and chapter SNBT writer serializes it into images; old click/hover not copied by fresh path. This is authored quest-graph navigation policy preserved across schema migration, not earned player progress, not picture-only display metadata, not runtime reward replay.

limits: Read-only static source reference; no network/game/production edits/checklist/ledger mutation/commit/push. Modern pinned 1.21 branch is not Forge1.20.1 source/API compatibility proof.

Legacy click presence wins even if current click_action is valid. Wrongtyped legacy getString yields empty→NONE and suppresses current. Unknown/empty prefix returns NONE, no opaque retention. URI.create can throw during readData; BaseQuestFile catches exception per object but fields already assigned and later flags/dependency may remain partially initialized.

fromString splits first colon; unknown/invalid type returns NONE. NONE detection writer uses identity rather than isNone, so NONE-like separately built action can emit none:data. Mixed old click not removed from reused caller compound; only actual fresh imageNBT writer proves omitted legacy keys.

Actual conversion does not markDirty itself. Base fileVersion mismatch marks dirty; unrelated same-version legacy click may remain on disk until other save trigger. SNBT.write implementation, server save scheduling/atomicity, full network dispatch and persistence success not audited. ChapterImage declared STREAM_CODEC read/write is support only, not proof packet delivered.

ChapterImage.shouldShowImage allows null dependency, including unresolved dependency id; editor bypasses gating in actual QuestPanel. Navigation target method resolves existence but does not itself enforce target task progression locks or claim rewards. No claim click grants/executes gameplay task.

Actual OPEN_QUEST does nothing with absent QuestScreen; unknown id logs. Optional page set only when current viewed quest already equals target, before open; first navigation to new target may ignore requested page. Integer page minus1 not clamped here. Full downstream quest page renderer clamp not read.

URI external opener, custom-event external listeners and FTBLibraryClientUtils.execClientCommand implementation not read/executed. No server command permission guarantee inferred. Recipe lookup/docs API are current options not additional legacy owners. showDocs split limit3 makes len>=4 anchor path unreachable; not used as proof full book routing.

No per-player completion state/reward custody is migrated; authored image data only. Existing Chapter sequencing policy remains separate comparator and no additional image transform/render fields counted.
